provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled neutral three-taxon multispecies coalescent, one lineage sampled per species, with no gene flow and independent unlinked loci. For an internal species branch of length t>=0 coalescent units, concordant probability=1-(2/3)*exp(-t), and EACH discordant probability=(1/3)*exp(-t). These are exact stipulated limiting proportions, not finite-sample estimates requiring a confidence interval.
calibration: No effective population size, generation time or absolute time calibration is given. Coalescent units are the model time scale; topology probabilities alone do not determine years.
target: Invert the concordant probability, independently check both discordant probabilities and determine whether t is strictly positive under the stipulated model. Do not interpret the most frequent gene topology as the only permitted gene tree.
